title: React Frontend Developer - Master Track
description: Comprehensive, battle-tested learning path for becoming an industry-ready Frontend Engineer with React.

roadmapItems.title: HTML5 & Semantic Web Architecture
roadmapItems.description: Semantic markup, modern forms, accessibility standards (a11y), and document object tree.
roadmapItems.aiReason: Foundational cornerstone of all web development.

roadmapItems.title: CSS3 Styling, Flexbox & CSS Grid
roadmapItems.description: Box model, responsive design principles, Flexbox layouts, Grid systems, and CSS variables.
roadmapItems.aiReason: Essential for creating responsive, modern user interfaces across all screen sizes.

roadmapItems.title: Tailwind CSS & Utility-First Styling
roadmapItems.description: Utility classes, responsive variants, typography, and dark mode configuration.
roadmapItems.aiReason: Industry standard CSS framework for high-speed modern UI development.

roadmapItems.title: Responsive Landing Page & Component Library
roadmapItems.description: Build an end-to-end responsive landing page using semantic HTML, CSS Grid, and Tailwind CSS.
roadmapItems.aiReason: First hands-on portfolio asset cementing layout mastery.

roadmapItems.title: Modern JavaScript (ES6+) & DOM Manipulation
roadmapItems.description: Closures, prototypes, destructuring, promises, async/await, and event handling.
roadmapItems.aiReason: Core programming engine powering React and all modern web interactions.

roadmapItems.title: Frontend Foundations Diagnostic Checkpoint
roadmapItems.description: Comprehensive evaluation covering HTML, CSS, Responsive Layouts, and JavaScript basics.
roadmapItems.aiReason: Verifies technical readiness before moving into React framework engineering.

roadmapItems.title: Git & GitHub Version Control
roadmapItems.description: Branching strategies, pull requests, merge conflict resolution, and collaborative workflow.
roadmapItems.aiReason: Crucial engineering tool required for teamwork and production code deployment.

roadmapItems.title: React Core Fundamentals, Hooks & State
roadmapItems.description: JSX, props, useState, useEffect, custom hooks, and unidirectional data flow.
roadmapItems.aiReason: Primary frontend UI library required for modern industry roles.

roadmapItems.title: TypeScript with React
roadmapItems.description: Type interfaces, generics, props typing, and strict type checking in React applications.
roadmapItems.aiReason: Significantly reduces runtime bugs and improves code maintainability in production.

roadmapItems.title: Production-Grade React SaaS Dashboard
roadmapItems.description: Build a multi-page interactive dashboard with state management, API integration, and charts.
roadmapItems.aiReason: Flagship portfolio project demonstrating full frontend engineering capability.
